Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

get.description: Answers the tenants the calling account holds an active membership in, with each tenant's name, display name and kind. No identifier is exposed: the name is what a client addresses the tenant by. The display name is the organization's, empty when its profile names none; a surface falls back to the name then. The kind is business or personal, a closed set the host's resolver supplies; an assembly without a resolver reads every tenant as business. A membership that is suspended is left out, as is a tenant whose roster state is not active and an identifier the roster does not carry. The list is in the membership read's order, a stable enumeration over tenants the view exposes by name alone, and is empty rather than absent when the caller holds none. The route resolves no tenant and requires no permission: every authenticated caller reads its own memberships. A membership, roster or kind read that cannot answer is a 503, never an empty list.

schema.description: The tenants the calling account holds an active membership in.

tenants.description: The tenants whose membership is active and whose roster row is active, in the membership read's order. Empty when the caller holds none.

displayName.description: The organization's display name, empty when its profile names none. A surface falls back to the name then.

kind.description: The tenant's kind: business for an ordinary tenant, personal for the single-person space a host derives for an account. The value is a closed set; a client branches on it rather than on the name.

name.description: The tenant's name, which the request surface addresses it by.

200.description: The tenants the caller holds an active membership in

503.description: The membership table or the roster snapshot could not answer

get.summary: List the tenants the caller holds an active membership in
